attempts.summary: Deployed inventory-api as a systemd-managed service on node1 (RHEL 10) with OOMScoreAdjust=-1000/OOMPolicy=continue so the kernel OOM killer skips it. Verified under a real, unbounded memory-hog process that drove the system OOM: the hog (pid 1715, oom_score_adj=0) was the process the kernel killed, while inventory-api (pid 1658) stayed active throughout with zero restarts and kept serving HTTP requests. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id, rebooted node1 via `systemctl reboot`, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified inventory-api came back enabled/active and serving with OOM protection intact.
